description: Affine.Earth math court: one tool, every court domain. domain+role+source run LatticeDomainIntegration (geometry Ehrhart, chance QPR, algebra Connes, physics table, health, finance, integer industry courts, QMA 2-local / spin-glass / N-rep / permanent, QC-001..019 presented-config verifiers, QC-021 presented (k,Q), affine_key Q-only expose, and the minecraft court). MINECRAFT: domain=minecraft with mc_op=project ingests one position (mc_x/y/z as the eight bytes the game sent, hex double bit patterns) onto the exact lattice at 2^32 units per block; mc_op=adjudicate rules on one of eight claims named by mc_claim - reaches, moved_within, stands_on, fits_through, fall_damage, knocked_toward, can_place, can_see - each reading the mc_* fields declared below; mc_op=sweep tests a projectile against a wall. domain affine_key returns patoshi_expose + shors_qmt_witness + topological_shear; period_r carries an ECDLP scalar or is empty, never a shear label; no k. An EMPTY domain returns the court catalog: domain_count is the number of courts and domains names each with its roles and may_ingest fields - take the count from the catalog, not from any text. Decimal strings on the wire. Floats refused.

mc_centre_y.description: block Y at the centre of the enveloped context, e.g. 64.

mc_centre_z.description: block Z at the centre of the enveloped context, e.g. 8.

mc_claim.description: minecraft gameplay claim to adjudicate (mc_op=adjudicate), one of the eight verbs a player uses: reaches, moved_within, stands_on, fits_through, fall_damage, knocked_toward, can_place, can_see. e.g. stands_on. mc_gap_d_units.description: fits_through: depth of the gap in lattice units, e.g. 4294967296

mc_gap_h_units.description: fits_through: height of the gap in lattice units, e.g. 8589934592 for two blocks

mc_gap_w_units.description: fits_through: width of the gap in exact lattice units (2^32 = 4294967296 units per block), e.g. 4294967296 for one block

mc_health_points.description: fall_damage: the player health before the fall in whole points, e.g. 20 (full); omitted -> full health

mc_op.description: minecraft court operation: 'project' (ingest one position onto the exact lattice), 'adjudicate' (rule on a gameplay claim named by mc_claim) or 'sweep' (a projectile from mc_x/y/z to mc_to_x/y/z against the wall at mc_wall_x/y/z). Defaults to project. e.g. adjudicate

mc_tick.description: the server tick this context describes, an integer the caller supplies: the law never reads a clock, so a run can be replayed, e.g. 20.

mc_to_x.description: minecraft target X as a hex double bit pattern, for adjudicate and sweep, e.g. 4022000000000000 for 9.0.

mc_to_y.description: minecraft target Y as a hex double bit pattern, for adjudicate and sweep, e.g. 4050000000000000 for 64.0.

mc_to_z.description: minecraft target Z as a hex double bit pattern, for adjudicate and sweep, e.g. 4021000000000000 for 8.5.

mc_toward_x.description: knocked_toward: X of the point of interest the knockback is judged against, hex double bit pattern, e.g. 4014000000000000 for 5.0

mc_toward_y.description: knocked_toward: Y of the point of interest as a hex double bit pattern, e.g. 4050000000000000 for 64.0.

mc_toward_z.description: knocked_toward: Z of the point of interest as a hex double bit pattern, e.g. 4021000000000000 for 8.5.

mc_wall_thin_units.description: sweep: wall thickness in lattice units when thinner than one block, e.g. 1073741824 for a quarter block

mc_wall_x.description: sweep: block X of the wall the projectile is tested against, integer as a decimal string, e.g. 3

mc_wall_y.description: sweep: block Y of the wall (optional; the wall spans the flight otherwise), e.g. 0

mc_wall_z.description: sweep: block Z of the wall (optional), e.g. 0

mc_window_blocks.description: edge of the enveloped context in whole blocks; outside it the court declines to answer rather than clamping, e.g. 16.

mc_x.description: minecraft position X as a 16-digit hex IEEE-754 double bit pattern, e.g. 4021000000000000 for 8.5. The eight bytes the game sent, not a re-encoded decimal.

mc_y.description: minecraft position Y as a 16-digit hex IEEE-754 double bit pattern, the eight bytes the game sent (see mc_x), e.g. 4050000000000000 for 64.0.

mc_z.description: minecraft position Z as a 16-digit hex double bit pattern (see mc_x), e.g. 4021000000000000 for 8.5.

pdb_id.description: the four-character PDB entry id, e.g. 4HHB. Read by complex/chemist, complex/researcher, complex/steward, pdb/crystallographer, pdb/researcher, pdb/steward; post it only for those domains - a court names the fields it grades on in its REFUSED_NO_INSTANCE detail.

pearson.description: the Pearson symbol that travels with space_group, e.g. cF8. Read by material/crystallographer; post it only for those domains - a court names the fields it grades on in its REFUSED_NO_INSTANCE detail.

perm_den.description: denominator of the claimed fair-permutation probability, e.g. 120. Read by gofirst/combinatorist, gofirst/steward; post it only for those domains - a court names the fields it grades on in its REFUSED_NO_INSTANCE detail.

perm_num.description: numerator of the claimed fair-permutation probability, e.g. 1. Read by gofirst/combinatorist, gofirst/steward; post it only for those domains - a court names the fields it grades on in its REFUSED_NO_INSTANCE detail.

phase.description: the claimed eigenphase as num/den, e.g. 1/4. Read by qc_kickback/researcher, qc_qpe/researcher; post it only for those domains - a court names the fields it grades on in its REFUSED_NO_INSTANCE detail.

phases.description: the n QFT phases as num/den, comma-separated, e.g. 0/4,1/4,2/4,3/4. Read by qc_qft/researcher; post it only for those domains - a court names the fields it grades on in its REFUSED_NO_INSTANCE detail.

phi_in.description: inflow flux as a whole number, e.g. 8. Read by fluids/certifier, fluids/cfd_vendor, fluids/designer; post it only for those domains - a court names the fields it grades on in its REFUSED_NO_INSTANCE detail.

phi_out.description: outflow flux as a whole number; the residual phi_in - phi_out is graded, e.g. 8. Read by fluids/certifier, fluids/cfd_vendor, fluids/designer; post it only for those domains - a court names the fields it grades on in its REFUSED_NO_INSTANCE detail.

pn_pred_s.description: predicted P-wave travel time in whole seconds, e.g. 53. Read by seismic/treaty; post it only for those domains - a court names the fields it grades on in its REFUSED_NO_INSTANCE detail.

polytope_id.description: the named polytope the Ehrhart count is taken over, e.g. unit_square. Read by geometry/cad_engineer, geometry/digital_twin, geometry/regulator; post it only for those domains - a court names the fields it grades on in its REFUSED_NO_INSTANCE detail.

presentation.description: a group presentation token; declared by algebra roles, not read by the Connes verdict today (algebra grades word), e.g. a2b. Read by algebra/phenomenologist, algebra/qft_theorist; post it only for those domains - a court names the fields it grades on in its REFUSED_NO_INSTANCE detail.

proper_divisors.description: the proper divisors of r as decimal strings, comma-separated (REQUIRED by qc_period), e.g. 1,2. Read by qc_period/researcher; post it only for those domains - a court names the fields it grades on in its REFUSED_NO_INSTANCE detail.

q.description: the claimed Eisenstein q of the word (qc_topo) or the dynamo q, e.g. 0. Read by dynamo/researcher, dynamo/steward, dynamo/theorist, qc_topo/researcher; post it only for those domains - a court names the fields it grades on in its REFUSED_NO_INSTANCE detail.

q_bin.description: the momentum-transfer bin index, e.g. 1. Read by qcd/jet_analyst, qcd/phenomenologist; post it only for those domains - a court names the fields it grades on in its REFUSED_NO_INSTANCE detail.

q_hex.description: a secp256k1 public point as 130-hex uncompressed (04...) or 66-hex compressed, e.g. 0279be667ef9dcbbac55a06295ce870b07029bfcdb2dce28d959f2815b16f81798.

queries.description: the query bit strings, ';'-separated (a comma-separated list is REFUSED_SHAPE), e.g. 100;010;001. Read by qc_bv/researcher; post it only for those domains - a court names the fields it grades on in its REFUSED_NO_INSTANCE detail.

r.description: the claimed period r (qc_period) or the Eisenstein r (qc_topo, dynamo), e.g. 4. Read by dynamo/researcher, dynamo/steward, dynamo/theorist, qc_period/researcher, qc_topo/researcher; post it only for those domains - a court names the fields it grades on in its REFUSED_NO_INSTANCE detail.

ratio_ppt.description: short/long flux ratio in parts per thousand, e.g. 5000. Read by eht/detector, eht/experimentalist; post it only for those domains - a court names the fields it grades on in its REFUSED_NO_INSTANCE detail.

residual_int.description: the integer residual a CFD vendor reports; declared by fluids/cfd_vendor, not read by the fluids verdict today (fluids grades phi_in and phi_out), e.g. 0. Read by fluids/cfd_vendor; post it only for those domains - a court names the fields it grades on in its REFUSED_NO_INSTANCE detail.

rho2.description: qma_nrep: 2x2 rational 2-RDM, rows by |, entries num/den, e.g. 1/2,0/1|0/1,1/2

role.description: the role on that domain, from the catalog; the role names which may_ingest fields the court reads, e.g. gnss (with domain eclipse).

rounds.description: the number of QPR rounds, e.g. 8. Read by chance/compiler, chance/consensus, chance/quantum_info; post it only for those domains - a court names the fields it grades on in its REFUSED_NO_INSTANCE detail.

scenario.description: biosphere/regulator joint ledger, one of measured_2025 | authorised_19408 | gen3_filed_100000 | orbital_data_centres, e.g. measured_2025.

score_den.description: denominator of the claimed score; declared by cs/ml_engineer, not read by the cs verdict today, e.g. 10. Read by cs/ml_engineer; post it only for those domains - a court names the fields it grades on in its REFUSED_NO_INSTANCE detail.

score_num.description: numerator of the claimed score; declared by cs/ml_engineer, not read by the cs verdict today, e.g. 9. Read by cs/ml_engineer; post it only for those domains - a court names the fields it grades on in its REFUSED_NO_INSTANCE detail.

short_median_ujy.description: short-baseline median flux in micro-jansky, e.g. 1500000. Read by eht/detector, eht/experimentalist; post it only for those domains - a court names the fields it grades on in its REFUSED_NO_INSTANCE detail.

snr_ppt.description: signal-to-noise in parts per thousand, e.g. 20000. Read by seismic/station, seismic/treaty; post it only for those domains - a court names the fields it grades on in its REFUSED_NO_INSTANCE detail.

source.description: attribution for the ingest (who or what posted it); absence is refused, e.g. court-client.

space_group.description: the space-group number, an integer in 1...230, travelling with a Pearson token, e.g. 227. Read by material/crystallographer, material/steward; post it only for those domains - a court names the fields it grades on in its REFUSED_NO_INSTANCE detail.

spins.description: discrete spins +1,-1,... one per site, e.g. 1,-1,1.

start.description: the starting vertex, 0 or 1, e.g. 0. Read by qc_walk/researcher; post it only for those domains - a court names the fields it grades on in its REFUSED_NO_INSTANCE detail.

station.description: ozone station code; declared by biosphere/ozone_column, not read by the verdict today (biosphere grades scenario), e.g. BLD. Read by biosphere/ozone_column; post it only for those domains - a court names the fields it grades on in its REFUSED_NO_INSTANCE detail.

steps.description: the number of walk steps, >= 0, e.g. 2. Read by qc_walk/researcher; post it only for those domains - a court names the fields it grades on in its REFUSED_NO_INSTANCE detail.

table.description: the truth table of f as a bit string, e.g. 00. Read by qc_dj/researcher; post it only for those domains - a court names the fields it grades on in its REFUSED_NO_INSTANCE detail.

table_counts.description: table row counts, comma-separated integers, e.g. 3,4,5. Declared by physics/detector and physics/experimentalist. The physics court grades none of clock, track or table_counts: whatever integers are posted, its verdict is CONTRACT, never WIN or MISS.

tau_s.description: elimination time constant in whole seconds; declared by health/clinician, not read by the health verdict today (health grades mass_milli, vol_milli, arm_counts), e.g. 3600. Read by health/clinician; post it only for those domains - a court names the fields it grades on in its REFUSED_NO_INSTANCE detail.

term.description: the coupling term named; declared by biosphere/coupling, not read by the verdict today (biosphere grades scenario), e.g. residence_time. Read by biosphere/coupling; post it only for those domains - a court names the fields it grades on in its REFUSED_NO_INSTANCE detail.

threshold_ticks.description: loss threshold in whole ticks; declared by finance/risk, not read by the finance verdict today (finance grades lots and ticks), e.g. 10. Read by finance/risk; post it only for those domains - a court names the fields it grades on in its REFUSED_NO_INSTANCE detail.

ticks.description: price move in whole ticks; PnL = lots * ticks exact in Z, e.g. 5. Read by finance/auditor, finance/clearing, finance/trader; post it only for those domains - a court names the fields it grades on in its REFUSED_NO_INSTANCE detail.

track.description: the track index of the table row, e.g. 1. Declared by the three physics roles; no verdict reads it: the physics verdict is CONTRACT whatever integers are posted.

travel_s.description: measured P-wave travel time in whole seconds, e.g. 53. Read by seismic/station, seismic/treaty; post it only for those domains - a court names the fields it grades on in its REFUSED_NO_INSTANCE detail.

vertices.description: vertex count of the polytope; declared by geometry/cad_engineer, not read by the Ehrhart verdict today (geometry grades polytope_id and dilation), e.g. 4. Read by geometry/cad_engineer; post it only for those domains - a court names the fields it grades on in its REFUSED_NO_INSTANCE detail.

vol_milli.description: dose volume in millilitres, > 0, e.g. 20000. Read by health/clinician, health/pharmacist; post it only for those domains - a court names the fields it grades on in its REFUSED_NO_INSTANCE detail.

word.description: the group word the Connes court grades, from its corpus, e.g. Z2_a2b. Read by algebra/phenomenologist, algebra/qft_theorist, qc_topo/researcher; post it only for those domains - a court names the fields it grades on in its REFUSED_NO_INSTANCE detail.

x.description: the first input bit string (qc_simon: 00) or the solution vector as num/den rationals (qc_hhl: 3/1,5/1), e.g. 00. Read by qc_hhl/researcher, qc_simon/researcher; post it only for those domains - a court names the fields it grades on in its REFUSED_NO_INSTANCE detail.

y.description: the second input bit string; x XOR y must equal mask, e.g. 11. Read by qc_simon/researcher; post it only for those domains - a court names the fields it grades on in its REFUSED_NO_INSTANCE detail.

year.description: calendar year of the ledger row; declared by biosphere/mass_ledger and biosphere/ozone_column, not read by the verdict today (biosphere grades scenario), e.g. 2025. Read by biosphere/mass_ledger, biosphere/ozone_column; post it only for those domains - a court names the fields it grades on in its REFUSED_NO_INSTANCE detail.
